---
title: "Macro Monitor: forecast test"
subtitle: "Can any model forecast next month's move better than a rule of thumb?"
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown

from pdi import site

board, meta = site.load("macro", "leaderboard")
holdout, hold_meta = site.load("macro", "holdout")
folds, fold_meta = site.load("macro", "folds")
fc, fc_meta = site.load("macro", "forecasts")
v = meta.get("verdict") or {}
```

## Result

```{python}
#| output: asis
if not v:
    print(site.empty_state(meta, "Forecast test"))
else:
    print(f'::: {{.verdict}}\n**{v["statement"]}**\n\n'
          f'Holdout error ({v["holdout_n_forecasts"]:,} one-month-ahead forecasts from '
          f'{v["holdout_start"][:7]} to {v["data_end"]}, scaled so 1.0 is the size of an '
          f'ordinary monthly change): baseline `{v["baseline"]}` '
          f'{v["holdout_scaled_mae_baseline"]:.3f}, picked model `{v["picked"]}` '
          f'{v["holdout_scaled_mae_picked"]:.3f}. Improvement {v["holdout_improvement"]:.3f} '
          f'against a fold-to-fold spread of {v["fold_spread"]:.3f}.\n\n'
          f'Published model: **{v["published"]}**.\n'
          f'{site.finding_line(v.get("finding"))}:::')
```

The test, written before any result was seen: AutoGluon fits a set of forecasting models on
every series up to the start of the validation year, the best one on the validation year is
picked, and the pick is scored once on the months after it. It must beat the best of four
rules of thumb (repeat last month's move, repeat the move of twelve months ago, the average
move, the average move for that calendar month) by more than the spread of its improvement
across the four quarters of the validation year. If it does not, the page says "no signal
found" and no forecast is published anywhere on the site.

## Holdout

Scored once, after the pick. The leaderboard below is not the result; this table is.

```{python}
if not holdout.empty:
    display(Markdown(holdout.assign(published=holdout["published"].map({True: "Yes", False: ""}))
        [["model", "kind", "n_forecasts", "scaled_mae", "published"]].rename(columns={
        "model": "Model", "kind": "Kind", "n_forecasts": "Forecasts",
        "scaled_mae": "Scaled error", "published": "Published"})
        .to_markdown(index=False, floatfmt=".3f")))
```

## Leaderboard (validation year)

Every model tried. The rules of thumb are always rows.

```{python}
if not board.empty:
    display(Markdown(board[["rank", "model", "kind", "scaled_mae", "n_forecasts"]].rename(columns={
        "rank": "Rank", "model": "Model", "kind": "Kind", "scaled_mae": "Scaled error",
        "n_forecasts": "Forecasts"}).to_markdown(index=False, floatfmt=".3f")))
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
if v:
    print(f'AutoGluon TimeSeries {v["autogluon_version"]} last trained on {v["trained_at"][:10]} '
          f'with a {v["time_limit_s"]}-second limit, on CPU, over {v["n_series"]} series. '
          f'It retrains weekly, not on every run.')
```

## Fold-to-fold spread

```{python}
if not folds.empty:
    display(Markdown(folds.rename(columns={
        "fold": "Fold", "months": "Months", "n_forecasts": "Forecasts",
        "baseline_scaled_mae": "Baseline error", "picked_scaled_mae": "Picked model error",
        "improvement": "Improvement"}).to_markdown(index=False, floatfmt=".3f")))
```

## Forecasts for next month

```{python}
#| output: asis
if fc.empty:
    print(site.empty_state(fc_meta, "Forecasts"))
else:
    print(site.finding_line(v.get("finding")))
    t = fc.assign(target_month=pd.to_datetime(fc["target_month"]).dt.strftime("%Y-%m"))[
        ["country", "name", "target_month", "forecast", "baseline_forecast"]].rename(columns={
        "country": "Economy", "name": "Series", "target_month": "Month",
        "forecast": "Forecast move", "baseline_forecast": "Baseline's forecast"})
    print(t.to_markdown(index=False, floatfmt=".2f"))
print(site.source_note(meta))
```
